name: Thunderbrew
summary: In Westfall, Grimbooze Thunderbrew gathers fresh hops for his next batch. Without them, his ale may turn thick as stew, so he shares kegs with those who bring what he needs.

sections.title: A Dwarven Passion in Westfall
sections.body: Far from Dun Morogh, Grimbooze keeps his family's brewing tradition alive. He insists on proper hops for his current brew, or it may turn to thick stew instead of refreshing ale.

sections.title: The Art of the Keg
sections.body: Grimbooze praises hops, barley, yeast, and malt in cheerful rhymes. Fresh hops let him finish fermentation on the spot. In return, he shares whole kegs of Thunderbrew Lager, known for its forceful taste.

faq.answer: Grimbooze Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer who roams Westfall. Wherever he camps, he keeps his clan's brewing tradition alive and chants in cheerful rhymes.
Without fresh hops, Grimbooze's latest batch may turn thick and heavy like stew instead of crisp lager. Hops bring bitterness and balance to the brew.
Thunderbrew Lager is a potent dwarven drink made by the Thunderbrew family. Grimbooze shares it by the keg, and its strong taste hits the palate hard.

faq.q: Can you bring Grimbooze hops more than once?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimbooze welcomes more hops and offers more kegs of his brew in return.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
faq.answer: The work takes place in Westfall, where Grimbooze camps and gathers supplies among the farmlands.

faq.q: Is Grimbooze related to the Thunderbrews in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Yes. Grimbooze shares his surname and brewing trade with the Thunderbrew family of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may welcome seeing a kinsman keep Kharanos's brewing traditions alive on Westfall's rugged frontier, especially when kegs are involved.
As a cook, you know barley, malt, and hops must balance, much like the ingredients in classic dwarven brewing.
